resolution: Replaced the material browser's wrapping row cards with fixed visual preview tiles backed by hmsc-int asset data: shader recipes/presets render real WGSL Effect previews, stored texture files render images, stored decals render DecalSurface docs, and cooked texture blobs resolve by hash without duplicating base64 into every row. Increased material paging to fixed visual slots and moved long row metadata into the selected-material controls so labels no longer wrap over neighboring content.
